snippet.title: Rock 'Em Sock 'Em Robots (Game Boy Advance longplay)
snippet.description: I can honestly say this is the worst game i've played that I can remember. The special attacks are useless. It is much easier to spam a basic attack. Some special attacks barely hit the robot. My video also broke so I had to play through this twice.
